metadata.title: MedOrbits Fees Database
metadata.description: Structured fee information for courses, institutions and academic years. Amounts are added only from official sources.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify every amount, currency and fee component against the official fee notification or institution before publication.

totalAnnualFee.note: Only set if published by the official source; do not compute silently.

totalCourseFee.note: Only set if published by the official source.

dataRules: Every fee record must have a unique id.
courseId must reference an existing course; institutionId may be null for centrally managed fees.
countryCode must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and currency must be ISO 4217.
Amounts must be numbers in the stated currency, never strings with symbols.
Never invent, estimate or average fee amounts; use null when unknown.
totalAnnualFee and totalCourseFee must come from the official source or be null; do not present computed totals as official.
Each component must state its frequency so annual, one-time and per-semester amounts are not confused.
Fees differ by institution, quota and year; never display a fee without its academicYear and quotaCategory.
Fee records must link to the official notification or institution page in sourceUrl before being marked verified.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together; 'verified' requires sourceUrl.
Outdated fee records must be reviewed before display, and unverified records must be labelled as such.
The active field controls display only.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm fees with the official institution or authority.
displayRules.disclaimer: Fees are indicative and can change. Confirm the latest amounts and refund terms with the official source before paying.
